HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: 42-year-old with 2-day history of left knee swelling and pain after a fall while running. Denies fever or numbness.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS: Negative for fever, chills, or other joint involvement.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: No chronic conditions.

VITALS: BP 122/78, HR 76, Temp 98.4F, RR 14.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Left knee mild effusion, tender medially, full range of motion, no instability.

ASSESSMENT: Likely medial collateral ligament sprain.

PLAN: RICE protocol, ibuprofen as needed, knee brace, follow up in 2 weeks if not improving.
